hero.title: Welcome to
hero.subtitle: Your member account: join clubs, show your QR code at the entrance and keep your visits and documents in one place.

about.title: How it works
about.description: Clubs, salons and associations manage their members with PafPaf. You register once and use the same account in every club you belong to.

quality.title: One account
quality.description: Your profile, documents and signature are kept in your account and passed to a club when you join it.

community.title: Entry by QR code
community.description: Show your personal QR code at the club entrance. Your visits are saved to your history.

service.title: All your clubs in one place
service.description: Membership, visits and spending for each club are in your personal cabinet.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Create an account and join your club.
